subject.title: fix(cli): bound readInputFiles with size cap in capability-cli

question: Should capability CLI commands impose a hard 100 MiB per-file limit, and if so what aggregate input budget and user-facing contract should accompany it?
rationale: The branch changes existing accepted-input behavior while its chosen threshold and total-memory policy are not established by the supplied source or PR discussion.

options.title: Define and enforce an input budget
options.body: Adopt a documented per-file and aggregate budget, preserve clear errors, and add regression coverage plus a real CLI proof.

options.title: Use an existing downstream contract
options.body: If a provider or capability layer already has an authoritative media limit, align the CLI validation with that limit and test the shared contract.

options.title: Do not add a CLI hard cap yet
options.body: Keep current input acceptance until maintainers select a compatibility-safe resource policy with an aggregate-memory strategy.

recommendation.title: Define and enforce an input budget
recommendation.body: Adopt a documented per-file and aggregate budget, preserve clear errors, and add regression coverage plus a real CLI proof.
